trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(:Team) WHERE r.tenure = 'latest' AND p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] WITH p.position AS position, MIN(CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64)) AS lowest_medals RETURN position AS col1, lowest_medals AS col2 ORDER BY col1
